name: spring-snapping-slider
title: Spring Snapping Slider
description: A numeric range control where the thumb glides with simulated mass and snaps toward discrete notched positions via magnetic spring detents.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Continuous Drag Notched Snap: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
